title: MedCache: Efficient and Temporally Valid Memory for Longitudinal Clinical Agents
summary: Longitudinal clinical agents must maintain an evolving patient state from evidence distributed across visits, time points, and specialties. However, how agent memory should be designed for this setting remains unclear. We introduce a benchmark of multi-visit, multi-specialty patient records that evaluates long-context evidence retrieval, cross-time evidence aggregation, and cross-specialty clinical reasoning. Using this benchmark, we systematically study four memory design choices: curation, organization, retrieval, and memory-augmented reasoning. We find that temporal validity is more important than simply retaining more history; specialty-factorized memory reduces context but can hide shared evidence; and multiple agents help when specialists must reason together, not merely when evidence comes from multiple memories. Guided by these findings, we propose \textit{MedCache}, a hybrid framework that constructs temporally valid patient memory, organizes evidence into overlapping specialty views, routes each query to relevant memories, and adaptively invokes one or multiple specialists. Experiments show that MedCache improves reasoning accuracy and memory efficiency over strong single-agent and multi-agent baselines, while generalizing across model backbones and external datasets.
tldr: MedCache introduces a benchmark for multi-visit, multi-specialty patient records and systematically studies memory design for clinical agents, leading to a hybrid framework (MedCache) that improves reasoning accuracy and memory efficiency over baselines.
tldr_zh: MedCache 提出了一个多就诊、多专科患者记录的基准，系统研究了临床代理的记忆设计，并提出了一个混合框架（MedCache），在推理准确性和记忆效率上优于基线方法。
summary_zh: 纵向临床智能体必须根据分布于多次就诊、多个时间点和多个专科的证据来维护演变的患者状态。然而，针对这一场景的智能体记忆应如何设计尚不明确。我们引入了一个基于多次就诊、多专科患者记录的基准，用于评估长上下文证据检索、跨时间证据聚合以及跨专科临床推理能力。利用该基准，我们系统研究了四种记忆设计方案：策展、组织、检索和记忆增强推理。我们发现时间有效性比单纯保留更多历史记录更为重要；专科分解记忆减少了上下文长度但可能隐藏共享证据；多个智能体仅在专科医生必须共同推理时才有帮助，而并非仅当证据来自多个记忆时。基于这些发现，我们提出了\textit{MedCache}——一种混合框架，该框架构建时间有效的患者记忆，将证据组织成重叠的专科视图，将每个查询路由到相关记忆，并自适应地调用一个或多个专科智能体。实验表明，与强大的单智能体和多智能体基线相比，MedCache在提升推理准确性和记忆效率的同时，还能跨模型骨干和外部数据集进行泛化。

title: Module Number Adaptive Visual Shape Control for Serial Modular Soft Robots
summary: Image based shape control provides a simple means of controlling the whole body configuration of soft robots. However, existing data driven approaches are typically developed for fixed robot structures and require new control data when the number of modules changes. This paper presents a module number adaptive visual shape control method for serial modular soft pneumatic robots. A controller trained only on single module actuation shape data is reused for robots with one to five modules by decomposing whole body camera images into local module patches. A single common module segmenter localizes individual modules across all tested configurations, while the same local controller is applied to every extracted patch. Geometric data augmentation improves transferability to downstream modules, and a lightweight mask reconstruction network reconstructs a synthetically removed actuator mask channel. Experiments on physical robots demonstrate shape control across varying numbers of modules and under environmental changes and payload loading. The results show that single module control learning enables scalable whole body control without configuration specific control data collection.
tldr: This paper presents a method for visual shape control of serial modular soft robots that adapts to varying numbers of modules without retraining, using a single module controller and image decomposition.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于串行模块化软体机器人的视觉形状控制方法，能够自适应不同数量的模块而无需重新训练，通过图像分解和单模块控制器实现。
summary_zh: 基于图像的形状控制为软体机器人的全身构型控制提供了一种简便方法。然而，现有数据驱动方法通常针对固定机器人结构开发，当模块数量改变时需要重新采集控制数据。本文提出了一种面向串联模块化软体气动机器人的模块数量自适应视觉形状控制方法。通过将全身相机图像分解为局部模块图像块，仅基于单模块驱动形状数据训练的控制器可复用于一至五个模块的机器人。一个通用的单一模块分割器可在所有测试构型中定位各个模块，同时同一局部控制器被应用于每个提取的图像块。几何数据增强提高了对下游模块的可迁移性，轻量级掩膜重建网络可重建被合成移除的执行器掩膜通道。物理机器人实验表明，该方法在模块数量变化、环境变化及负载条件下均能实现形状控制。结果表明，单模块控制学习无需针对特定构型采集控制数据即可实现可扩展的全身控制。

title: Toward Trustworthy Robot-Assisted Sliding Palpation for Shallow Vessel Localisation with a Calibrated Digital Twin
summary: Reliable localisation of shallow subsurface vessels is important for safe robot-assisted venous access and vessel-aware manipulation, but collecting diverse tactile data on physical hardware is costly, time-consuming, and can degrade soft vision-based tactile sensors. We present a robot-assisted sliding-palpation framework in which a calibrated digital twin generates labelled tactile sequences, reducing reliance on real-world data. The twin models sensor-vessel contact, is calibrated against real palpation trajectories using Bayesian-optimisation-based domain adaptation, and is randomised over sliding direction and contact conditions. A spatio-temporal graph neural network trained on simulated marker trajectories performs per-node vessel classification and produces a human-verifiable top-view localisation map through 2D-to-3D-to-2D geometric projection. We evaluate three datasets: Sim, Silicone, and Meat, the latter a raw-meat phantom with vessel models at nominal depths of 0 to 30 mm, using four train-to-test configurations: Sim to Sim, Sim to Silicone, Sim to Meat, and Meat to Silicone. The calibrated twin achieves a simulated-to-real marker-alignment mean absolute error of 0.50 mm at deepest contact across four canonical interactions. After reprojection onto a 1 mm top-view grid, predicted vessel pixels lie on average 1.05 to 5.49 mm from the nearest true vessel pixel across the four models, with 1.05 to 1.31 mm for all except Sim to Meat. The larger error for Sim to Meat reflects the greater domain shift and current limit of simulation transfer. These results demonstrate progress toward trustworthy tactile palpation through calibrated simulation, interpretable localisation, and transparent cross-domain evaluation. Code, model weights, and data are publicly available on GitHub and Zenodo.
tldr: This paper presents a robot-assisted sliding palpation framework using a calibrated digital twin and spatio-temporal graph neural network to localize shallow subsurface vessels, reducing reliance on real-world tactile data and achieving millimeter-level localization accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种机器人辅助滑动触诊框架，利用校准的数字孪生和时空图神经网络定位浅表皮下血管，减少了对真实触觉数据的依赖，并实现了毫米级定位精度。
summary_zh: 浅表皮下血管的可靠定位对于安全的机器人辅助静脉穿刺和血管感知操作至关重要，但在物理硬件上收集多样化的触觉数据成本高、耗时长，且可能损坏基于视觉的软体触觉传感器。我们提出了一种机器人辅助滑动触诊框架，其中经过校准的数字孪生生成带标签的触觉序列，从而减少对真实世界数据的依赖。该孪生模型模拟传感器-血管接触，通过基于贝叶斯优化的域自适应根据真实触诊轨迹进行校准，并在滑动方向和接触条件上进行随机化处理。一种在模拟标记轨迹上训练的时空图神经网络执行逐节点血管分类，并通过二维到三维再到二维的几何投影生成可人工验证的俯视定位图。我们评估了三个数据集：Sim、Silicone和Meat，后者是一个生肉体模，血管模型位于0至30 mm的名义深度，采用四种训练到测试的配置：Sim→Sim、Sim→Silicone、Sim→Meat和Meat→Silicone。经校准的孪生模型在四种典型交互中，最深接触点处的模拟到真实标记对齐平均绝对误差为0.50 mm。在重新投影到1 mm网格的俯视图后，四个模型中预测的血管像素与最近真实血管像素的平均距离为1.05至5.49 mm，除了Sim→Meat外，其余均为1.05至1.31 mm。Sim→Meat的较大误差反映了更大的域偏移和当前仿真迁移的局限性。这些结果表明，通过校准仿真、可解释的定位和透明的跨域评估，在实现可信赖的触诊方面取得了进展。代码、模型权重和数据已在GitHub和Zenodo上公开。

title: Scalable Clinical Data Infrastructure and Comparative ML Evaluation for Hospitalisation Risk Prediction in Elderly Patients with Multiple Long-Term Conditions using CPRD
summary: Deep learning architectures are increasingly proposed for patient trajectory modeling in electronic health records (EHRs), yet their advantage over simpler, more interpretable models is rarely subjected to rigorous empirical scrutiny in real-world clinical settings. We present a comprehensive patient timeline pipeline applied to elderly patients in CPRD Aurum, incorporating 260 clinical conditions classified via a three-tier automated framework including specialised detection logic for 17 complex conditions. Using this infrastructure, we benchmark Temporal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks (TG-CNN) against Logistic Regression with LASSO regularisation and Random Forests for predicting 12-month all-cause emergency hospitalisation risk, motivated by (but not filtered to) the elevated risk of adverse drug reactions. Under cross-validation, TG-CNN achieves a marginally higher mean AUC-ROC than LASSO (0.712 vs. 0.705), whereas on the held-out test set LASSO achieves the highest discrimination of three models (AUC-ROC 0.733, versus 0.710 for Random Forest and 0.702 for TG-CNN). We show, that discrimination alone is an incomplete criterion for clinical deployment: after Platt calibration, LASSO is the only model with an acceptable calibration slope (0.817), while Random Forest (0.759) and, TG-CNN (0.391) remain substantially miscalibrated. We argue that LASSO, not the highest-discriminating model, is the model best suited to direct clinical deployment. We present lessons for the machine learning and healthcare community regarding data infrastructure, model selection, and value of calibration and interpretability in high-stakes decision support.
tldr: This paper develops a scalable data infrastructure for EHRs of elderly patients and benchmarks deep learning (TG-CNN) against simpler models (LASSO, Random Forest) for 12-month hospitalization risk prediction. It finds that while TG-CNN has marginally higher AUC-ROC in cross-validation, LASSO achieves better discrimination on a held-out test set and significantly better calibration, arguing it is more suitable for clinical deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文针对老年患者电子健康记录开发了可扩展的数据基础设施，并基准测试了深度学习（TG-CNN）与更简单模型（LASSO、随机森林）在12个月住院风险预测中的表现。研究发现，尽管TG-CNN在交叉验证中AUC-ROC略高，但LASSO在保留测试集上判别力更好且校准显著更优，因此认为它更适合临床部署。
summary_zh: 深度学习架构越来越多地被用于电子健康记录（EHR）中的患者轨迹建模，但在真实临床环境中，其相较于更简单、更可解释的模型的优势却很少受到严格的实证检验。我们提出了一条全面的患者时间线流程，应用于CPRD Aurum中的老年患者，该流程整合了通过三层自动化框架分类的260种临床状况，其中包含针对17种复杂状况的专门检测逻辑。利用这一基础设施，我们将时间图卷积神经网络（TG-CNN）与带LASSO正则化的逻辑回归及随机森林进行基准比较，以预测12个月内全因急诊住院风险，其动机源于（但不限于）药物不良反应风险的升高。在交叉验证下，TG-CNN的平均AUC-ROC略高于LASSO（0.712对0.705），而在保留测试集上，LASSO在三个模型中实现了最高的区分能力（AUC-ROC为0.733，随机森林为0.710，TG-CNN为0.702）。我们表明，仅凭区分能力并不能作为临床部署的完整标准：经过Platt校准后，LASSO是唯一具有可接受校准斜率（0.817）的模型，而随机森林（0.759）和TG-CNN（0.391）仍存在显著的校准偏差。我们认为，LASSO——而非区分能力最高的模型——才是最适合直接临床部署的模型。我们为机器学习和医疗健康社区总结了关于数据基础设施、模型选择以及校准与可解释性在高风险决策支持中价值的经验教训。

title: Adaptive Finite-Time Position-Force Control of Teleoperation Systems With Time-Varying Delays Using a Liquid State Machine Uncertainty Estimator
summary: Teleoperation systems are increasingly used in medical, rehabilitation, and remote manipulation applications, where accurate position/force tracking and stable interaction are essential. In such applications, the remote environment may exhibit viscoelasticity, frictional memory, contact transitions, and other dynamic interaction effects, causing the system response to depend not only on the current state but also on its previous evolution. This history dependence, together with communication delays and uncertain nonlinear dynamics, makes accurate uncertainty compensation particularly challenging. Conventional feedforward neural approximators do not inherently retain temporal information, while fully recurrent architectures may introduce additional computational and online training complexity. To address this limitation, this article introduces the first application of a liquid state machine (LSM) to bilateral teleoperation control. A finite-time adaptive controller is developed using a hybrid position/force auxiliary error system with velocity and force filters, while the LSM is employed to estimate uncertain dynamics by exploiting its intrinsic temporal processing and fading-memory capabilities with a simple adaptation mechanism. Closed-loop stability and finite-time convergence are established through a Lyapunov--Krasovskii framework. Simulations in spring--damper and generalized Maxwell viscoelastic environments demonstrate improved position and force tracking and lower mean execution time compared with an RBFNN-based controller.
tldr: This paper presents a teleoperation control method using a liquid state machine (LSM) to estimate uncertain dynamics, achieving finite-time position/force tracking under time-varying delays with simulations in viscoelastic environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用液体状态机（LSM）估计不确定动力学的遥操作控制方法，在时变延迟下实现有限时间的位置/力跟踪，并在粘弹性环境中进行了仿真验证。
summary_zh: 遥操作系统越来越多地应用于医疗、康复和远程操控领域，这些场景中精确的位置/力跟踪与稳定交互至关重要。在此类应用中，远程环境可能呈现粘弹性、摩擦记忆、接触切换及其他动态交互效应，导致系统响应不仅取决于当前状态，还受制于其历史演变过程。这种历史依赖性，加之通信时延与不确定的非线性动力学特性，使得精确的不确定性补偿尤为困难。传统前馈神经逼近器本质上无法保留时序信息，而全递归架构则可能引入额外的计算与在线训练复杂度。为解决这一局限，本文首次将液体状态机（LSM）应用于双边遥操作控制。基于带有速度与力滤波器的混合位置/力辅助误差系统，设计了一种有限时间自适应控制器；利用LSM固有的时序处理与衰减记忆能力，通过简单的自适应机制实现对不确定动力学的估计。通过Lyapunov—Krasovskii框架建立了闭环稳定性与有限时间收敛性。在弹簧-阻尼器及广义Maxwell粘弹性环境下的仿真表明，相较于基于RBFNN的控制器，所提方法实现了更优的位置与力跟踪性能，并降低了平均执行时间。
